name: Solace PubSub+ source connector for Eventstream
description: Eventstream now provides a Solace PubSub+ source connector, letting you stream events from Solace event brokers into Microsoft Fabric. This adds support for a popular enterprise messaging platform for real-time analytics.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to Solace PubSub+ brokers.- Stream broker events into Fabric destinations.- Process Solace data with no-code operators and SQL operator.
